title: The dispatch of a released offer, the home of its release instant and validity period, and the source of the customer facts are not specified for rwb-treatment
source: Legacy RWB-E3-007 (04 User stories/Recovery Workbench User Stories Epics 3 to 8 v3.md lines 1565 to 1662); FSD S2 TDR, settlement and deed in lieu v3 A2.7; TSD S2 TDR, settlement and deed in lieu v2 T3.1, T5.3 and T-A.1; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 rows R-RES-04 and R-RES-11; Context pack S2 (service and ownership rows); Template and Rules v1 R5.5 DP-05, DP-09, DP-14 and R7.2 s12
section: 3 Preconditions; 4 Flow steps 7 to 10; 7 Acceptance criteria AC1 and AC3; 11 Data; 12.1; 12.3; 12.5; 13 Solution plan
description: One combined row for the send of a released offer. (1) No source fixes how the released offer reaches the customer: FSD S2 v3 A2.7.2 names Workbench, WIN, NSS and LINE OA as integration points with no contract, no template and no channel, and Architecture v5 slide 13 shows no REST line from S2 to P6 while it shows rwb-comms listening to S2's events, so the target can only dispatch by event and no source names that event as the release's. (2) TSD S2 T3.1 gives treatment no send-date, channel, letter-reference or validity-period column, so the release instant and the period have no home in the table the legacy story's data section names. (3) The validity period and the offer clock are stated only as service-level values - 'offer validity 14 days' on R-RES-09, R-RES-11 and R-SET-06 and '2 working days' on R-RES-04 - and as 'Offer 14 days' in Temporal and Drools Design slide 18; no parameter key is defined for either. (4) The legacy data table names v_ace_customer (DF-ACE-055 to DF-ACE-074) as the source of the letter, while Architecture v5 slide 8 says the 30 recovery.v_ace_* views are read only by rwb-source-data, so no source states how rwb-treatment would obtain the addressee.
evidence: FSD S2 v3 A2.7.2 ('Integration points. Workbench, WIN, NSS, LINE OA') and A2.7.4.1 AC-S2-007-01; legacy RWB-E3-007 section 7 AC1 ('Then sends the offer to the customer and starts the validity clock. The wait is a timer, not a routed state') and section 11 (recovery_case, assignment, timer, v_ace_customer, treatment, decision_log_entry); TSD S2 v2 T3.1 (DF-TRT-001 to DF-TRT-033, no send-date and no period column) and T5.3 (TreatmentApproved, published); Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 rows R-RES-04 ('2 working days') and R-RES-11 ('offer validity 14 days'); Architecture v5 slide 13 (S2 Treatment row: no P6 REST cell; P6 Comms row: E on S2) and slide 8 notes ('the 30 recovery.v_ace_* views (read only by rwb-source-data)'); Template and Rules v1 R5.5 DP-05 and DP-09
area: Contract and data: dispatch event for a released offer, release instant, validity and clock periods, customer facts
owner_role: Tech lead of rwb-treatment with the P6 owner of the letter and the P1 owner of the ACE views
proposed: Publish the working read of ASM-B2-S2-002-1 and ASM-B2-S2-002-3 in RWB-S2-E3007-CON and apply it to RWB-S2-E3007-APP: the release is dispatched as rwb.treatment.TreatmentApproved.v1 on rwb.treatment.events.v1 with key caseId, consumed by rwb-comms for the letter and rwb-payment for the expectation of the money, and the event carries no customer value because the addressee is resolved by the letter; the release instant is a request-context fact recorded on the decision record, valid_until is the only column written, and the validity period and the offer-preparation clock are exported as parameter keys rather than given values. Confirm with the P6 owner of the letter and the P1 owner of the ACE views at the wave 2 contract freeze.

title: The release body, its required set, the release trigger path, the body of EV-10 and the release instant have no published shape
source: Ambiguity across Architecture v5 slide 18 and slide 42 row 10; Recovery Workbench API Specification v4 x-module S2; TSD S2 TDR, settlement and deed in lieu v2 T-A.1 and T5.3; legacy RWB-E3-007 sections 7, 11 and 19; Template and Rules v1 R3 and R5.5 DP-09 and DP-13
section: 3 Preconditions; 7 Acceptance criteria AC1 to AC5; 8 Business rules; 11 Data; 12.1; 12.3; 12.7; 13 Solution plan
description: One combined row for the release contract. (1) No source publishes a release body: TSD S2 T3.1 gives treatment fields and TSD T-A.1 gives four treatment paths with no request or response field list, so the properties of OfferRelease and its required set are defined nowhere. (2) No source states how a release is triggered: the legacy story's endpoint table lists the treatment read and the treatment submit, API Specification v4 and TSD S2 T-A.1 API-S2-004 name POST /treatments/{treatmentId}/submit, and Architecture v5 slide 18 names POST /treatments/{id}/offer, so the release rides one of those and this contract publishes no path of its own. (3) No source lists the body of EV-10 although Architecture v5 slide 42 names the event and its consumers, so its eleven properties are a working read. (4) No source states the idempotency of the event path or how a redelivery of a business event of this service is deduped, and no source gives treatment a column for the release instant.
evidence: TSD S2 v2 T-A.1 (API-S2-001 to API-S2-004, no release path) and T-A.2 (Request TreatmentRequest, Response Treatment, no field list) and T5.3 ('TreatmentApproved | Published'); Architecture v5 slide 18 ('REST GET/POST /treatments - POST /treatments/{id}/offer') and slide 42 row 10 (event 10 with its consumers); legacy RWB-E3-007 section 7 AC1 and AC3 and section 11 ('| treatment | id, case_id, decision_log_id, treatment_type, proposed_by, proposed_at and 8 more |'); Template and Rules v1 R3 item 1 above item 6, R5.5 DP-09 and DP-13, R7.2 s12
area: Contract: release element, trigger path, event body and idempotency
owner_role: Solution architect with the rwb-treatment tech lead and the P6 and P8 owners
proposed: Publish the working read of ASM-B2-S2-002-4 in RWB-S2-E3007-CON: OfferRelease with six properties, three of them required, five mapping to treatment fields and releasedAt recorded on the decision record; the release rides the offer operation that RWB-S2-E3002-CON publishes on base /api/recovery/treatment/v1 and declares no path of its own; the EV-10 body is the eleven properties of section 12.3 with key caseId and no customer value; a redelivery is deduped by cloud event id in the inbox and by the Idempotency-Key on the operation. Confirm with the solution architect, the P6 and the P8 owners at the wave 2 contract freeze.
